operations.name: read_device_control
operations.desc: Read the Device Control Register (CTRL) to get device status and capabilities
operations.returns: 32-bit control register value with device enable/disable, link reset, and other control flags

operations.name: read_device_status
operations.desc: Read the Device Status Register (STATUS) to check link state and speed
operations.returns: 32-bit status register with link up/down, duplex mode, and speed information

operations.name: read_interrupt_cause
operations.desc: Read the Interrupt Cause Read Register (ICR) to identify pending interrupts
operations.returns: 32-bit interrupt flags indicating transmit, receive, link change, or error events

operations.name: read_rx_desc_base
operations.desc: Read the Receive Descriptor Base Address Register (RDBAL) for RX queue location
operations.returns: 32-bit physical address of the receive descriptor ring base

operations.name: read_tx_desc_base
operations.desc: Read the Transmit Descriptor Base Address Register (TDBAL) for TX queue location
operations.returns: 32-bit physical address of the transmit descriptor ring base

operations.name: read_rx_queue_head
operations.desc: Read the Receive Queue Head pointer (RDH) for current RX position
operations.returns: 32-bit index of the next descriptor to be processed by hardware

operations.name: read_tx_queue_head
operations.desc: Read the Transmit Queue Head pointer (TDH) for current TX position
operations.returns: 32-bit index of the next descriptor to be transmitted

operations.name: read_mac_addr_low
operations.desc: Read MAC address lower 32-bits from Receive Address Low Register (RAL)

operations.name: read_mac_addr_high
operations.desc: Read MAC address upper 16-bits from Receive Address High Register (RAH)
operations.returns: 32-bit value with MAC address bytes 4-5 in lower 16 bits and valid flag
